violation_type.title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report (26 TAC §744.201(5))
violation_type.short_title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation has not provided updated procedures regarding abuse/neglect reporting.

finding_variants.text: The operation has not provided updated procedures regarding abuse/neglect reporting.

It was determined that the permit holder did not ensure that suspected abuse/neglect of a child was directly reported to the TX Abuse/Neglect Hotline by the employee. The operation's reporting procedures outline instructions requiring initial notification to the employee's direct supervisor prior to submitting a report.

During an inspection it was found that a child made an outcry of suspected abuse and this was not reported to licensing within the 48 hour timeframe. I spoke to the person in charge about being mandated reporters and how to make a report.
At the time of assessment, the operation has not provided verification of updated abuse/neglect reporting procedures.
